comments.value: @{5acad9ecc9dba010c9c3ec68|full_name} I wish one could also be able to gift their own private avatars as well in the case where their friend decides to make an avatar from scratch that only their friend and them could use or even their community without marking them as public, or an option for public avatars to be not discoverable in the website's search bar or even search worlds without knowing the avatar's ID first.
It's on the way! No ETA yet, but we're working on it.

@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name} It doesn't work from the website; there's nothing I can do to make it work. If I try to do it from the in-game shop, I get an error message saying that the owner cannot give away their own product from the shop. 

All you had to do was add an option from the marketplace menu on the website dashboard to be able to donate a copy of the avatar to a user.

@{690b1b1a4f8511f380f847c5|full_name} Thank you for pointing that out!

You can buy avatars from the world stores of certain avatar creators. For example:

https://vrchat.com/home/world/wrld_0766796f-4af6-415f-9662-fb3bd8b4ff41/store

However, the avatar marketplace is currently not available on VRChat.com, and you can't view avatar listings directly.

I created a feature request for buying (and gifting) avatars through the website: https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-marketplace/p/allow-users-to-view-and-buy-avatar-listings-on-vrchatcom

Separately, avatar sellers requested the ability to gift their own avatars to other users. This feature request is tracked on our seller feedback board: https://feedback.vrchat.com/avatar-marketplace-sellers/p/gift-your-own-avatars-free-to-people

details:
Add a gifting feature that allows users to buy avatars for other users.

Though this idea was already discussed in the FAQ thread in the forum ( https://ask.vrchat.com/t/avatar-marketplace-faq-for-sellers/43555 )
